phases.name: Comprehensive Discovery
actions: Gather all relevant context from codebase, configs, logs
Review recent changes and system state
Identify all integration points and dependencies
phases.completion_criteria: Complete understanding of problem domain with evidence

phases.name: Root Cause Analysis
actions: Trace data flows and service interactions
Review error logs and stack traces
phases.completion_criteria: Root cause identified with supporting evidence

phases.name: Solution Design
actions: Consider all edge cases and failure modes
Plan for county data isolation if applicable
Document rationale for all design decisions
phases.completion_criteria: Complete solution design with rationale documented

phases.name: Precision Implementation
phases.completion_criteria: Solution implemented with tests and monitoring

phases.name: Exhaustive Verification
actions: Run full test suite and verify all pass
Verify county data isolation if applicable
phases.completion_criteria: All tests pass, compliance verified, performance validated

phases.name: Comprehensive Documentation
actions: Log decision trail for future reference
phases.completion_criteria: All documentation complete and up to date

architecture: Implement repository patterns for data access
data_access: Always include countyCode parameter for county-specific data
Validate data isolation in multi-tenant scenarios
error_handling: Implement retry logic for transient failures
logging: Log at appropriate levels (Debug, Info, Warning, Error)
testing: Write unit tests for all business logic
Create integration tests for service interactions
Include performance tests for critical paths

process.name: Data Collection
process.description: Gather all relevant data, metrics, logs, and system state

process.name: Evidence Analysis
process.description: Analyze collected evidence objectively without assumptions

process.name: Option Evaluation
process.description: Evaluate all viable options with pros/cons documented

process.name: Decision
process.description: Make decision based on evidence and evaluation

process.name: Rationale Documentation
process.description: Document decision rationale with supporting evidence

process.name: Outcome Tracking
process.description: Track decision outcomes and validate against expectations

actions: Halt current operation if risk of data corruption
Escalate to appropriate team with full context
Do not proceed with assumptions - wait for clarification

rules: Never mark a task complete without verification
Never defer a problem that can be fixed now
Never make assumptions - always gather evidence
Never skip documentation - it's part of the solution
Never leave broken code - fix it or rollback
Never compromise on quality - do it right the first time
